card.name: Child-Pugh liver impairment scores
card.fires_on: Inside the Child-Pugh grading in hepatic impairment dosing text, on "ugh", the space or "Class" before the grade, and the colon or space before score numbers. Also on the number in UGT1A1 genotypes like 6/6.

modes.label: Child-Pugh wording
modes.description: The "ugh" of Pugh, or the space/"Class" right before the grade letter or score, in hepatic impairment dosing.

modes.label: Score number slot
modes.description: The blank space after "score:" just before the numeric range of the Child-Pugh score.

modes.label: UGT1A1 genotype
modes.description: The number in a UGT1A1 allele genotype such as 6/6.

card.plain: It fires inside the Child-Pugh liver grading phrase, just before the class letter or score range appears.
